d:
01 - Marinette Dupain-Cheng (AKA Ladybug) is out to fight crime today! But she is faced with an armed villain who wields a Massively THICC weapon! Will she be able to defeat him swiftly?
02-03 - Ladybug was quickly defeated by the villain and put on her knees! Before she was able to do a hero's monologue to find a plan to reverse the situation, he gets ahead and starts having some fun with her!
04-05 - Marinette gets a chance to break free from her choking hazard and strikes back! She draws her weapon but good heavens!!! She catches herself in her own trap and the witty villain wastes no time exploring her other hidden goods~
06-07 - With Ladybug defeated in this encounter the villain decides to humiliate her further by filling her up as she was exposed for the world to see! Unable to resist she has to take his seed deep into her womb!
08 - The hours fly by and it's time to part with our favourite hero after our villains had their fun with her! Maybe she'll let everyone know when she's out crime fighting again so they can meet up again!
